notes.text: Team standup: Priya is blocked on the login bug, Tomas will pair with her after lunch. Release candidate cut moved to Friday.
notes.title: Standup 4 March

notes.text: Met with finance about Q3 spend. Cloud costs are up 12 percent; agreed to turn off the unused staging cluster by the end of the month.
notes.title: Budget review

notes.text: Landing page redesign: keep the hero image, shorten the headline, move pricing above the fold. Mara to mock up two variants.
notes.title: Design sync

notes.text: Ms Alvarez says Noah reads well but rushes his maths. Practise times tables for ten minutes each evening.
notes.title: Parent teacher meeting

notes.text: Strong on system design, a bit shaky on testing. Good communicator. Recommend a second round with the backend lead.
notes.title: Interview notes: Sam

notes.text: What went well: fewer hotfixes. What did not: unclear ownership of the on-call rota. Action: Dana writes a one page rota policy.
notes.title: Retro

notes.text: Wants to move toward mentoring. We agreed he leads the onboarding session for new hires next month.
notes.title: One to one with Luis

notes.text: Next meeting at Hana's place on the 18th. We are reading a novel about a lighthouse keeper; bring snacks.
notes.title: Book club

notes.text: Saute onion, carrot and celery, add red lentils, cumin and vegetable stock. Simmer twenty minutes, finish with lemon juice.
notes.title: Lentil soup

notes.text: Two cups flour, two tablespoons sugar, one egg, milk until the batter is pourable. Rest ten minutes before frying.
notes.title: Pancakes

notes.text: Three ripe bananas, mashed, with melted butter, sugar, an egg and flour. Bake at 175 degrees for an hour.
notes.title: Banana bread

notes.text: Fry garlic and ginger, add garam masala, tomatoes and chickpeas. Serve with rice and plain yoghurt.
notes.title: Chickpea curry

notes.text: Blend basil, pine nuts, parmesan, garlic and olive oil. Toss through pasta with a spoon of the cooking water.
notes.title: Pesto

notes.text: Half a cup of oats, half a cup of milk, a spoon of chia seeds. Leave in the fridge overnight, top with berries.
notes.title: Overnight oats

notes.text: Feed the starter at night, mix the dough in the morning, fold every thirty minutes, shape in the evening, bake the next day.
notes.title: Sourdough schedule

notes.text: Simmer peppers and tomatoes with paprika, make wells in the sauce, poach eggs in it for six minutes.
notes.title: Shakshuka

notes.text: Flight lands at 9:40 on Friday. Hotel near Alfama. Day two: tram 28, then pastries in Belem.
notes.title: Lisbon trip

notes.text: Boots, rain jacket, two pairs of wool socks, headlamp, water filter, first aid kit, trail mix.
notes.title: Packing list for the hiking weekend

notes.text: Leaves King's Cross at 8:00, arrives 12:30. Book a seat by the window; sandwiches from the station.
notes.title: Train to Edinburgh

notes.text: Kyoto temples in the morning, Osaka street food in the evening. Buy a rail pass before leaving.
notes.title: Japan ideas

notes.text: Pick up the car at the airport counter, bring the licence and a credit card for the deposit. Return it with a full tank.
notes.title: Car rental pickup

notes.text: Tent, sleeping bags, stove, gas canister, matches, torch, bug spray. Check the campsite booking for the 14th.
notes.title: Camping checklist

notes.text: Apply for the travel authorisation at least a week before departure; the fee is small and approval is usually quick.
notes.title: Visa reminder

notes.text: Drive to the coast Saturday morning, rent paddleboards, dinner at the fish shack by the harbour.
notes.title: Beach weekend

notes.text: Squats 4x8 at 80 kg, Romanian deadlifts 3x10, walking lunges 3x12, calf raises to finish.
notes.title: Leg day

notes.text: Easy 5k in 28 minutes, felt strong at the end. Next time try intervals: one minute fast, one minute slow.
notes.title: 5k run

notes.text: Thirty lengths freestyle, ten with a pull buoy, stretched shoulders after. The pool closes at 8.
notes.title: Swim session

notes.text: Hip openers and long holds. The instructor suggested a block under the hands for pigeon pose.
notes.title: Yoga class

notes.text: Bench press 5x5, pull-ups 4x6, shoulder press 3x10, finished with planks.
notes.title: Upper body

notes.text: Rode 40 km along the river, headwind on the way back, average speed 24 km/h.
notes.title: Cycling log

notes.text: Ten minutes every morning: cat cow, thoracic rotations, hamstring stretch, hip flexor stretch.
notes.title: Mobility routine

notes.text: Long run on Sundays adding one km a week, tempo run on Wednesdays, rest day on Friday.
notes.title: Half marathon plan

notes.text: Check-up moved to Thursday at 3 pm. Ask about the sensitive tooth on the lower left.
notes.title: Dentist

notes.text: The kitchen tap drips. Call Mr Okoye on Monday; he can come Wednesday morning between 8 and 10.
notes.title: Plumber

notes.text: Eggs, oat milk, spinach, tomatoes, coffee beans, dishwasher tablets, bin bags.
notes.title: Groceries

notes.text: The photo must be taken against a white background; renewal takes about three weeks, so start before the summer.
notes.title: Passport renewal

notes.text: Annual service booked for the 22nd. Someone needs to be home; clear the space under the stairs.
notes.title: Boiler service

notes.text: Three books are due back on Saturday; renew the cookbook online if no one has reserved it.
notes.title: Library books

notes.text: For Mum: a silk scarf or a pottery class. For Dad: a good torch or a book on birds.
notes.title: Birthday gift ideas

notes.text: Wash the windows, sort the wardrobe, donate clothes that no longer fit, deep clean the oven.
notes.title: Spring cleaning

notes.text: Small changes compound. Make the cue obvious, the habit easy and the reward satisfying.
notes.title: Reading notes: Atomic Habits

notes.text: Practise the verbs for daily routines: despertarse, ducharse, desayunar. Ten new words each day.
notes.title: Spanish vocabulary

notes.text: A reminder app that nudges you to water plants only when the soil is dry, using a cheap moisture sensor.
notes.title: App idea

notes.text: Episodes for the commute: one about the history of salt, one about urban beekeeping.
notes.title: Podcast list

notes.text: Practise the open chords G, C, D and Em for fifteen minutes with the metronome at sixty beats per minute.
notes.title: Learn guitar

notes.text: Shoot at golden hour, use the rule of thirds, and keep the ISO low on a tripod for night scenes.
notes.title: Photography tips

notes.text: Finished the chapter on dictionaries and comprehensions. Exercise: count the words in a text file.
notes.title: Python course

notes.text: Five hundred words every morning before checking email. Draft the first chapter by the end of June.
notes.title: Writing goal

notes.text: Plant the seedlings after the last frost, water deeply twice a week, tie the stems to canes.
notes.title: Tomato plants

notes.text: Bruno's annual vaccination is due on the 9th. Also ask about his itchy ears and the dose of flea treatment.
notes.title: Dog vet visit

notes.text: Switch Miso to the salmon recipe gradually over a week to avoid an upset stomach.
notes.title: Cat food

notes.text: Mix kitchen scraps with dry leaves, turn the heap every two weeks, keep it damp but not soggy.
notes.title: Compost

notes.text: The monstera wants bright indirect light; the fern needs misting. Repot the rubber plant in spring.
notes.title: Houseplants

notes.text: Pump the tyres to 60 psi, oil the chain, check the brake pads before the weekend ride.
notes.title: Bike maintenance

notes.text: Restart the router when the connection drops; a firmware update is scheduled for Sunday night.
notes.title: Wifi router

notes.text: Pick a film everyone agrees on: the heist comedy won the vote. Popcorn and the big sofa.
notes.title: Movie night

notes.text: Redirect the post, book the removal van, take meter readings, label boxes by room.
notes.title: Moving checklist

notes.text: In bed by 22:30 all week, woke once in the night, felt rested. Cut caffeine after two in the afternoon.
notes.title: Sleep log

notes.text: Saturday at the school hall: lemon drizzle, brownies and flapjacks. We need volunteers for the tea table.
notes.title: Fundraiser bake sale

notes.text: The battery drains in two hours. Check background apps, lower the screen brightness, consider a replacement.
notes.title: Laptop battery

notes.text: Cook green lentils, let them cool, toss with feta, cucumber and mint. Served cold, so no stock and no simmering.
notes.title: Lentil salad

notes.text: One frozen banana, a cup of yoghurt, a handful of oats. Blend until smooth. Nothing to bake.
notes.title: Banana smoothie

notes.text: Grated carrot, walnuts and cinnamon. Bake at 180 degrees for 45 minutes, then cool before the cream cheese frosting.
notes.title: Carrot cake

notes.text: Low heat, stir all the time, take the pan off while the eggs still look glossy. A little butter, no milk.
notes.title: Scrambled eggs

notes.text: Roast tomatoes and garlic, blend with vegetable stock, finish with a splash of cream.
notes.title: Tomato soup

notes.text: Flight leaves Heathrow at 7:15 on Thursday and lands at 10:40. Hotel near Retiro Park, tapas on the first night.
notes.title: Madrid trip

notes.text: Leaves Euston at 9:10, arrives 11:15. The return ticket is open, so no need to book the way back.
notes.title: Train to Manchester

notes.text: Bus 7 runs every twenty minutes from the station and takes thirty-five minutes. Buy the ticket on the app.
notes.title: Airport bus

notes.text: Maybe Porto in the spring: port cellars, the river, a fado evening. Flights not looked at yet.
notes.title: Porto weekend idea

notes.text: Service and MOT booked for the 3rd. Leave the car at the garage by 8 and ask them about the squeaky brakes.
notes.title: Car service

notes.text: The renewal quote is 15 percent higher than last year. Compare three sites and ring the insurer before the 20th.
notes.title: Car insurance renewal

notes.text: Dumbbell curls 3x12, tricep dips, cable rows, lateral raises. No barbell this week, shoulders still sore.
notes.title: Arm day

notes.text: Slow ten kilometres on soft ground, heart rate low the whole way, no intervals and no watch.
notes.title: Trail run

notes.text: New goggles and a swimming cap needed before the membership starts. Check the locker size.
notes.title: Pool kit

notes.text: Registration for the autumn marathon opens on the first of next month. The fee is 60 pounds and places go quickly.
notes.title: Marathon registration

notes.text: Optician on Friday at 11. Bring the current glasses and the list of the screen hours at work.
notes.title: Eye test

notes.text: Fit a hose connector to the outside tap before the weekend. The tap itself is fine, no dripping.
notes.title: Garden tap

notes.text: Paid the plumber 85 pounds in cash. Keep the receipt to show the landlord.
notes.title: Plumber receipt

notes.text: The vet signs the pet travel certificate no more than ten days before the ferry. Microchip number is in the folder.
notes.title: Pet travel

notes.text: Table for six booked at the Italian place on the 12th at 7:30. Ask for the one by the window.
notes.title: Mum's birthday dinner

notes.text: Schedule long blocks of focus, shut the door, keep email for the afternoon. Shallow tasks go at the end of the day.
notes.title: Reading notes: Deep Work

notes.text: The garden centre sale is on Saturday. Buy compost and one large pot; no new plants until the shelf is cleared.
notes.title: Plant sale

notes.text: Compare two mesh kits, budget 150 pounds. Check that it works with the current modem.
notes.title: Mesh wifi kit

notes.text: Write down the frame serial number and register it with the police and the insurer. Lock through the frame, not the wheel.
notes.title: Bike security

notes.text: Monday: Sam at 10:00, Priyanka at 11:30, Marco at 14:00. Meeting room two is booked; print the CVs.
notes.title: Interview schedule

notes.text: The old pager app is being retired. Install the new one by Friday and test an alert on your own phone.
notes.title: Pager app

notes.text: Study guide chapters one to four, practice exam on Sunday, real exam on the 12th of December.
notes.title: Cloud certificate

notes.text: Warm shower, ten minutes of reading, phone in the other room by 22:00. Lights low from nine.
notes.title: Evening wind-down
